# Security Requirements-Quality Checklist: Security Hardening

**Purpose**: Formal pre-implementation gate — validate the *quality* of the security-hardening requirements (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage) and their alignment with the design artifacts, before `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-implement`.
**Created**: 2026-09-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [research.md](../research.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | [contracts/api.md](../contracts/api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does **not** mean implementation work is complete.

> These items evaluate the **requirements themselves** — whether they are written completely, clearly, consistently, and measurably — **not** whether the implementation behaves correctly.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are rate-limit requirements defined for **both** the sign-in and registration entry points, with the per-source and per-account dimensions and their distinct purposes (enumeration vs. source-IP rotation) stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 - Are the user-facing outcomes defined for session expiry and for a failed refresh (what the user experiences when a session ends mid-task), or is this an unaddressed gap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007/FR-008, §FR-027]
- [x] CHK003 - Is there a requirement making account removal an explicit, user-initiated action (confirmation, irreversibility, and where the request is surfaced), or is this a gap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK004 - Are the audit-event data requirements complete (attributable identity, action, target, outcome, timestamp; the minimum action list; inclusion of denied/failed attempts)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for which responses — the API **and** the served app document — must carry the browser-security and no-advertisement headers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004/FR-012, US6]
- [x] CHK006 - Is there a requirement defining the owner's visibility into a recipient's consent state in the owner's sharing view, or is this a gap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the boot-gate failure "clear, actionable message" (US3) specific enough to name which configuration value failed and what the operator must change? [Clarity, Spec §US3/FR-005/FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 - Are the access-credential lifetime (≤1 h) and the 30-day session cap expressed as **defaults with a documented operator-adjustable range**, rather than fixed constants? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 - Is "script-unreadable" (FR-009) precisely defined (e.g. `HttpOnly`/`Secure`/`SameSite` cookie or equivalent) **and** is `localStorage` explicitly prohibited? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the neutral placeholder ("????") defined with consistent semantics across the recipient list and the claimant display (a marker carrying no identifying attributes)? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, FR-021/FR-024]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 - Are FR-020 (registration **may** indicate an existing email) and FR-010 (share is indistinguishable) explicitly reconciled with the anti-enumeration rule so they are not misread as a conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010/FR-020, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the consent model (per-list, revocable, default-pending) consistent across FR-021–FR-025, the edge cases, and [data-model.md](../data-model.md)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021–FR-025, data-model]
- [x] CHK013 - Do the do-not-regress invariants (FR-016–FR-019) remain consistent with the new consent/identity and account-removal rules (removal must not newly disclose)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016–FR-019, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 - Are the session requirements (FR-007–FR-009, FR-026) consistent with the session entity's state transitions (active / revoked / expired) in [data-model.md](../data-model.md)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007–FR-009/FR-026, data-model]
- [x] CHK015 - Are the status-code and cookie-scoping semantics in [contracts/api.md](../contracts/api.md) (uniform 401/429 bodies, no `404` for unregistered share) consistent with the spec's enumeration-hygiene and script-unreadable-storage requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009/FR-010/FR-020, contracts]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 - Are SC-001–SC-009 each objectively measurable (quantified as 100%, 0, or a bounded N) **and** each mapped to at least one FR? [Measurability, Spec §SC]
- [x] CHK017 - Is SC-002 measurable given the threshold is operator-configurable (i.e. does it reference the *configured* per-window threshold rather than a hard-coded number)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002/FR-001]
- [x] CHK018 - Is SC-008's "0 occurrences of an email in any non-owner view" verifiable against an **enumerated set of response paths** (is that set defined)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008/FR-025]
- [x] CHK019 - Are the acceptance scenarios for each user story independently testable (Given/When/Then with no hidden cross-story dependencies)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US1–US8]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK020 - Are exception-flow requirements present for all new flows (refresh failure, stale-token replay, sign-out on an already-revoked session, removal while a pending invitation is outstanding)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-026]
- [x] CHK021 - Are recovery / re-entry flows defined (re-share after revocation resets consent; a recipient may re-consent after declining)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-023]
- [x] CHK022 - Are concurrent-operation scenarios defined (concurrent first-time registration, concurrent claim, **and** concurrent presentation of the same refresh token), or is the last a gap? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 - Are the pending-invitation failure modes covered (list deleted before registration, share revoked before registration, matching to an already-registered account)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-010]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK024 - Is **every** edge case in the spec traceable to at least one FR or SC (no orphan edge cases)? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 - Is the "throttled by an attack from a shared network address" edge case covered by the per-source budget with an explicit fairness / reset guarantee? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-001]
- [x] CHK026 - Is the "audit under failure" edge case (denied/failed attempts are still recorded) covered by FR-013 and SC-001? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-013, SC-001]
- [x] CHK027 - Are the "consent is per-list" and "declined consent + claiming" edge cases covered by FR-023/FR-024 and the data-model consent semantics? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-023/FR-024]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK028 - Are the performance / latency impacts of the new per-request session liveness check specified, or is their absence explicitly documented as out of scope? [NFR, Gap]
- [x] CHK029 - Is the behavior of the rate-limit / lockout state across an application restart (reset vs. persisted) specified? [NFR, Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK030 - Are data-protection requirements for audit content specified (no passwords, no secrets, no PII beyond the attributable identity)? [NFR, Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK031 - Are audit retention requirements (how long events are kept, any deletion policy) specified, or explicitly deferred? [NFR, Gap, Spec §FR-013]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 - Is the dependency on edge TLS termination (which `Secure` cookies rely on) documented as an assumption, with a local-development fallback? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK033 - Is the dependency on the trusted-proxy forwarded client IP (with fallback to the direct TCP peer) documented in FR-001 and the assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK034 - Is the **single-replica** assumption that the in-memory rate-limit design depends on documented in the spec, or does the spec require multi-replica correctness? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §FR-001, research D1]
- [x] CHK035 - Is the dependency on the existing test suites (SC-007) documented, including where those suites live and that they must continue to pass? [Dependency, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK036 - Are the deferrals (admin audit API out of scope; the app does not send email, so pending invitations match at registration) documented as explicit assumptions / out-of-scope with a pointer to the future feature? [Assumption, Spec §Out of Scope, Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK037 - Are the "one-time consent prompt" (FR-022) and "changeable at any time" (FR-023) reconciled (the prompt is one-time, but the choice is revocable via self-serve), or is this an ambiguity? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022/FR-023, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 - Is it specified whether the **owner** can alter or revoke a recipient's consent, or is consent strictly the recipient's own choice? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK039 - Is it specified what happens to a recipient's consent state when their account is removed (deleted with the account, or persisted on the share row)? [Gap, Spec §FR-014/FR-023]
- [x] CHK040 - Is it specified whether a rate-limited (`429`) authentication attempt is itself audited as a failure, and how that interacts with FR-013? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001/FR-013]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and **must not** modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`; it is not part of this custom checklist.
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK040) for easy reference.
- Focus areas: whole security-hardening feature (all 8 user stories) · Depth: formal pre-implementation gate · Audience: reviewer (PR) · Sources: spec.md + design-artifact consistency.
- Add comments or findings inline next to any item.
